name: ci-spend-check
description: Analyze GitHub Actions runs to find repeated failures, cancelled work and long-running workflows. Show the calculations and links behind each recommendation. Runtime is not billed cost; billing estimates require real usage data. This plugin does not disable workflows.

interface.longDescription: Analyze GitHub Actions runs to find repeated failures, cancelled work and long-running workflows. Show the calculations and links behind each recommendation. Runtime is not billed cost; billing estimates require real usage data. This plugin does not disable workflows.
defaultPrompt: Find recurring failures and wasted runtime in these GitHub Actions runs.
Audit this repository's recent workflow runs without changing settings.
Show which CI workflows deserve attention and link the evidence.
